records.title: The Next Paradigm Is User-Centric Agent, Not Platform-Centric Service
records.reason: Conceptual user-centric agent architecture; no concrete measured compute, memory, latency, or throughput improvement is established.

records.title: Generation Order and Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Models: An Information-Theoretic Perspective
records.reason: Information-theoretic analysis of generation order and parallel diffusion decoding; no new concrete serving optimization or direct measured efficiency gain.

records.title: The CUR Decomposition of Self-Attention Matrices in Vision Transformers
records.reason: Full text studies CUR decomposition of self-attention in vision transformers; its target is ViT attention analysis, not LLM serving/inference optimization.

records.title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling
records.reason: Efficient pretraining and training-compute scaling, not inference-time/serving efficiency.

records.title: CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe
records.reason: LLM-based GPU kernel generation/optimization is general kernel programming, not a demonstrated LLM inference-serving optimization.
